tools.name: query
tools.description: Search for verified method contracts for any library. Pass any text -- library name, method, what you're building, or an error you hit.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List all libraries and services that have verified method contracts. Use this first to discover what's available, then query for specific methods.

tools.name: list_methods
tools.description: List all methods for a given library or service. Use after list_services to drill into a specific one.

tools.name: policy
tools.description: Generate a least-privilege IAM policy for an AWS workflow. Pass a named workflow, explicit IAM actions, or a description. Returns the exact policy with confidence tier and any unresolved operations.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List the curated named workflows that can generate least-privilege IAM policies.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Feed a generated policy back to AWS's own policy evaluation engine (SimulateCustomPolicy) and confirm it grants exactly the intended operations and nothing extra. Returns verified (True|False|unknown), grants_all, grants_extra. Requires AWS credentials; without them verified=unknown with the reason.

tools.name: authorize
tools.description: Pre-flight authorization check for an AWS operation. Resolves the IAM actions the operation requires, then asks AWS's own policy simulator (SimulatePrincipalPolicy) whether the current role (or a given principal) allows them. Returns resolution (exact|partial|unresolved) and evaluation (allowed|deni

tools.name: register
tools.description: Register a fix. Three actions: confirm (it worked), append_thread (variant worked), new_receipt (nothing matched, I fixed it).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "query" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
